# Freeciv on AmigaOS 3.x, lab:freeciv, 2 November 2026: the time each
# turn's autosave was written (Amiga clock, List of User/saves).
# civ2civ3, 44 x 44, the Incas and six easy AIs plus animals.
# T1 to T3 played by hand; from T4 the Incas were put under AI
# control (/aitoggle) and 'timeout -1' let the server run each
# turn as soon as the AIs had moved, with the SDL2 client (sound on)

# receiving turns until it ended at about 20:32; from T182 the server ran
# alone. It was stopped with Break after T195.
